mechanism: L-AD1: the int64 materialization inside _adaround_mantissa's 16-pattern enumeration is removed. The two int64 code expressions are unchanged; the float32 conversion and 0.25 scaling move from the 16-fold-expanded tensor onto the two small (K, N, 8, 2) operands, so torch.where selects in float directly. The device-dependent mask is hoisted into a module cache. All 16 candidate patterns are retained.
parent: v231 complete root: Linear L-EM3 groupstep K=2 + v195 Attention

sole_change_measured.method: build.py cuts the parent's own _adaround_mantissa out of the parent bytes, substitutes one contiguous block, and appends the result as a shadow definition. It refuses to build unless the parent SHA256 and byte count match, that block occurs exactly once, the parent module's 473 statements are AST-identical in the candidate with exactly 3 appended, the function's 4-statement prefix and 7-statement suffix are identical, the change is confined to the contiguous window 4..9, the removed names bits_all/all_codes occur zero times and the added names floor_mant/ceil_mant occur exactly twice each.
sole_change_measured.why_not_a_positional_byte_diff: the shadow definition is appended, so a positional byte-by-byte comparison against the parent would report only the appended tail and say nothing about whether the rest changed. The real measures are reported instead: the AST equality of the parent's 473 statements, the contiguous changed-statement window inside the function, and the substitution count.
sole_change_measured.rebase_note: drafted against v230 (0f1af6db) and rebuilt on v231 after the official 18518/291s promotion, because building on v230 would have silently reverted the L-EM3 K=2 arm and the local pairing would have reported that reversion as this card's gain. The v230 build produced the same appended byte count and the same structural numbers.

single_file_import.where: a scratch directory holding only solution.py, imported by a fresh `python -I` interpreter started with cwd set to that directory and no repository path on sys.path
single_file_import.result: imports cleanly; all six public APIs are present and are executed there, not merely called through: weight calibration, the dynamic activation encoder, the Attention calibration, and the three dynamic Q/K/V encoders, each on synthetic inputs built inside the isolated process
single_file_import.why_a_separate_checker: verify.py itself imports the evaluator and loads the packed calibration cache out of the tree, so it cannot answer whether the candidate is a submittable single file
single_file_import.how_that_was_established: by the loaded function object's co_firstlineno (12366), which is greater than the parent file's line count (12325) -- read off the object, not inferred from the source text

legal_state.checked_by: the evaluator's own reference_hif4.validate_state and validate_hif4_params, called in-process on the states and parameters the same smoke returns, so the isolated run is not self-certifying
legal_state.recorded_caveat: on uniform random input hif4_calibration_attention returns empty identity states (it fits nothing to noise), which the evaluator's _check_attention_state then rejects for a missing num_heads. That is a property of the synthetic input, not of the candidate: the Q/K/V encoders are therefore driven by a state built explicitly to the legal contract at the same geometry, and the identity result is recorded as attention_calibration_identity_on_synthetic_input: true rather than hidden. The fitted-state -> Q/K/V path is covered by verify.py and by the 72 panel cases per shard, not by this smoke.

delta_reference: the v231 root ea79a1c1 itself, i.e. the same source the candidate is built on (artifacts/proxy_v3/linear-em3-cand, whose six shard files record source_sha256 ea79a1c12dc66714...)
shard_decision_note: the local tool's gate is `delta_mean > 0 and L1 < 0.02`, an eligibility screen for small local trends. Six zero shard means cannot pass it, and this archive does not claim a local pass. A zero here is the intended result, not a failed screen: the mechanism is proven value-identical, so a non-zero gain delta would have been a defect.

pairing_method.shards_0_5: a single candidate-side eval.py process paired out of process against the archived v231 baseline by workbench/full_solution/linear-ad1-adaround-materialization/pair_sixshard.py, which refuses files whose recorded source_sha256 disagree across shards or agree between sides
pairing_method.no_in_process_pairing: this run has no in-process paired baseline; the comparison is entirely cross-process, which is why the accuracy claim rests on the byte-level equivalence proof below rather than on the pairing alone

timing_comparability_note: `api_total_seconds` is NOT comparable across these runs and is recorded only because the tool writes it. It includes hif4_calibration_and_quantize_weight, which is 128-202 s on a calibration-cache miss and 0.0 s on a hit; the candidate side's shard-4 reading (201.96 s) is an outlier of exactly that kind. The comparable quantity is hif4_dynamic_quantize_activation alone -- 56 calls per shard on both sides, no calibration -- and even that is a cross-process, cross-time comparison with no null control. It is recorded as not-contradictory, not as this card's time evidence; the time evidence is timing.py's three-arm paired measurement with a byte-identical sham arm.
projection_note: no projection was recorded, and none is warranted: plan section 4.3's acceptance condition is a resolvable drop in the OFFICIAL seconds, and local seconds on this machine cannot be converted into official ones. Unknown official status is recorded as unregistered/NA rather than predicted from local wall clock.

controls.A_lineage_and_isolated_import: the candidate's first 505762 bytes are the parent's; the candidate is 510664 B; the parent holds exactly 1 definition of _adaround_mantissa and the candidate exactly 2, with the parent's own AST-identical in the candidate (a shadow, not an edit); the name binds to exactly 1 object and that object is the appended one; the candidate imports and runs all six APIs alone in a scratch directory under `python -I` with no repository path on sys.path. check_standalone_import.py recomputes the lineage against the working-tree root's own sha and refuses if it does not match the registered parent, so the archive does not rest on build.py's say-so.
controls.B_unit_equivalence: the parent's and the candidate's _adaround_mantissa are called directly on 403 combinations: 5 shapes (1-5 dims) x 4 dtypes x 10 value sets x 2 scale forms, plus 3 non-contiguous layouts. 0 differing, 0 raising on both sides, compared as raw uint8-view bytes (numpy().tobytes() is unusable for bfloat16, and the byte view also compares NaN payloads) -- not torch.equal, no tolerance.
controls.B_value_set_rationale: the values were chosen against the rewrite's own boundaries, not for generality: codes that land exactly on an integer (floor == ceil, the two candidates coincide), the asymmetric 6/7 clamps, codes below 0 and above 7, and inf / nan / very large / very small / mixed.
controls.C_activation_real_path: the real hif4_dynamic_quantize_activation, 4 groups: layer0/q (2560 channels, has Gram) and layer0/o (4096 channels, no Gram), each at 128 and 512 rows. All 5 output fields bit-identical in all 4 groups. This covers both branches of the Gram weighting.
controls.D_weight_real_path: the real hif4_calibration_and_quantize_weight, layer0/q and layer0/o, one full calibration each. weight_params and activation_state bit-identical on both.
controls.E_operator_reachability: verify.py counts _adaround_mantissa calls during the real weight calibration: layer0/q is 511 calls on BOTH sides with group_gram non-empty on every one of them, so the changed function is reached AND the changed branch is taken; layer0/o is 0 calls on both sides, so the no-Gram weight path never enters it. The call counts being equal is itself an invariant -- a change that touched control flow would show up here first.
controls.F_negative_control_in_timing: the two no-Gram whole-call rows in timing.py must show no effect, because layer0/o never calls the changed function (control E, 0 calls). Measured: 0.19x and 0.86x of the sham null with 15-16 of 31 rounds going the parent's way, i.e. indistinguishable from the null. The has-Gram rows are 34-52x the null.

reason: All 336 paired cases report a gain delta of exactly 0.0 (min 0.0, max 0.0; 0 positive, 0 negative). Behind that zero, the equality is proven for arbitrary input rather than sampled: the int64 code expressions are unchanged and an elementwise operator commutes with `where` by definition, so no precision assumption is needed and non-finite inputs are covered by the same argument. The rewrite is measured to remove real work -- 4.26% of a 128-row and 4.63% of a 512-row has-Gram dynamic call, against a sham null that is 34-52x smaller -- while the no-Gram path, which never calls the changed function, reproduces zero as required. The card's motive is the official 9s margin (291s against a 300s hard limit), not the score, which is why it took a bit-equivalence obligation rather than an accuracy one.
sibling_note: v235 descends from v231 and therefore carries the L-EM3 K=2 arm. It is NOT a descendant of v233 (L-TF1), which descends from v230 and serves as the fallback root; the two are not additively stackable without a rebuild.
declared_deviations: the mask cache _AD1_PATTERN_MASK_CACHE is new module-level state keyed by device string, only added to, read-only within a process. The change is not side-effect-free in the strict functional sense even though the value it replaces was bit-identical and input-independent.
